H: At the C73E N384 robust-teacher setting, a final compiler trained on the equal-weight mean of hierarchy and teacher targets establishes the -5pp reference safeguard and improves validation accuracy over hierarchy-only compiler targets.

T.teacher_and_data: exact C73E robust Residual-MLP at Gaussian sigma .36; C72E nested384 calibration; C10 digits train/validation split; no held-out test
T.H64: same C73E P64-adapted hierarchy, top adaptation seed+715000, 600 updates
T.S0: TinyRes(64,32) fitted to H64 shifted-calibration activations only
T.B50: same TinyRes fitted to 0.5*H64 shifted-calibration activations + 0.5*robust-teacher shifted-calibration activations
T.D64: same TinyRes fitted directly to robust-teacher shifted-calibration activations
T.pairing: identical final architecture, initialization, minibatch-index stream, data and teacher within seed; final target is the intervention
T.bootstrap_method: paired seed percentile95 with one common index matrix
T.preflight: bridge71300 H64/S0/D64 metrics, states and data hashes must match C73E N384 in the same environment; verification72300 and synthetic evaluator checks before fresh launch
T.environment: Python3.11, torch2.13.0 CPU, numpy2.4.6, scikit-learn1.9.0, torch threads1; actual CPU/build captured

D.gate_states: PASS: lower95>margin; FAIL: upper95<margin; otherwise UNCERTAIN
decision_order: B50 reference PASS and B50-minus-S0 accuracy lower95>0: HALF_BLEND_VALID_AND_IMPROVES_STANDARD
D.H64_and_S0_reference_gates: reported, not required to be failures; C73E final uncertainty is not assumed to reproduce as inferiority
D.descriptive_diagnostics: B50-D64, S0-H64, NMSE and raw MSE; no post-hoc mixture tuning

C: Final target anchoring may not help, or may help only on this fixed sample/model family.
S0 may already meet the safeguard on this new cohort; then improved accuracy is not evidence that S0 was intrinsically invalid.
D64 may remain better; no superiority of hierarchy over direct distillation is assumed.
U: This uses full teacher supervision during final compilation, so it cannot establish a small teacher-feedback dimension.
No causal uniqueness, universal optimal 50% mixture or cross-architecture transfer claim.
Intervals are conditional on fixed digits splits and calibration subsets, not independent dataset-level replication.
Raw MSE and separate denominators recorded; no speed, memory or energy claim.
All outcomes remain exploratory and a claim selected here requires independent fresh confirmation.
